    - name: customer360__name
      description: Deduplicated customer full names from Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk with lexicographic variant indexing per customer360_id
      grain: One row per unique full_name per customer360_id
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Start from marts.customer360__mapping to relate customer360_id to source system identifiers. - Collect name candidates via inner joins, excluding rows where the source name is NULL: - Marketo: join by lead ID; use full_name_clean. - Stripe (customer): join by customer ID; use customer_name_clean. - Stripe (shipping): join by customer ID; use shipping_name_clean. - Zendesk: join by user ID; use full_name_clean. - Union all candidates from all sources; any temporary source or index flags used during collection are ignored. - Deduplicate to unique (customer360_id, full_name) pairs; duplicates within a customer are removed, across customers are preserved. - For each customer360_id, sort remaining full_name values in ascending lexicographic order under the database’s default collation and assign a sequential index starting at 1. - Output columns: customer360_id, full_name, index.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer key; one row per unique full_name within each customer360_id.
      - name: full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name taken as-is from upstream cleaned fields; NULLs are excluded, empty strings may appear; deduplicated per customer360_id; the exact string determines ordering for index.
      - name: index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sequential position within each customer360_id after deduplication, starting at 1 and ordered by full_name ascending; consecutive integers with no gaps; not based on source priority.
    - name: customer360__organization
      description: Distinct organization names per customer360_id, alphabetically indexed after consolidating Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk sources
      grain: One row per distinct organization_name per customer360_id
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Read marts.customer360__mapping to obtain customer360_id and source identifiers: - marketo_lead_id → intermediate.int_customer360__marketo.lead_id - stripe_customer_id → intermediate.int_customer360__stripe.customer_id - zendesk_user_id → intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk.user_id - Collect organization names via inner joins; exclude rows where the selected name is NULL: - Marketo: organization_name_no_suffix; Marketo inferred: inferred_organization_name_no_suffix - Stripe: customer_organization_name_no_suffix; Stripe shipping: shipping_organization_name_no_suffix - Zendesk: organization_name - Union all collected names across sources. - Deduplicate by exact string equality on (customer360_id, organization_name); casing and whitespace are preserved (no trimming or normalization). - Assign final index as the alphabetical position per customer360_id by ordering organization_name ascending using the database’s default collation; indices start at 1 and are contiguous. - Output customer360_id, organization_name, index.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer360 identifier from mapping used to group and index organizations; never NULL due to inner joins
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: organization_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization name from Marketo (no_suffix or inferred no_suffix), Stripe (customer or shipping no_suffix), or Zendesk; NULL names are excluded; duplicates removed per customer360_id by exact string match; original casing and spacing kept; used for alphabetical indexing
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Alphabetical rank within the deduplicated organization_name list for the customer360_id; starts at 1, contiguous, ordered by organization_name ascending; unrelated to any source-specific priority
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: customer360__organization_network
      description: Organization-level network, value, health, engagement, risk, ranking, and strategy metrics grouped by standardized_org_name + email_domain (INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER excluded)
      grain: One row per (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      - marts.customer360__customer_value_analysis
      business_logic: '- Build organization_entities: - Join behavior_analysis to lifecycle_metrics on primary_email; join behavior_analysis to value_analysis on primary_email. - Retain ids (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id), journey/segment fields, LTV/health/engagement fields. - Standardize fields: - standardized_org_name: uppercase and trim primary_organization; if null/blank set "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - email_domain: take the substring after "@" in primary_email; if missing set "unknown.domain". - organization_type by primary_organization text patterns: - null/blank → Individual - contains inc/corp/llc/ltd → Corporation - contains university/college/school → Education - contains government/dept/agency → Government - contains nonprofit/foundation/charity → Non-Profit - otherwise → Business - estimated_org_size: - domain in {gmail.com,yahoo.com,hotmail.com,outlook.com} → Personal - domain in {microsoft.com,google.com,amazon.com,apple.com,facebook.com} → Enterprise - else if name length > 20 → Large Business; > 10 → Medium Business; > 0 → Small Business; otherwise → Individual - Aggregate to organization_aggregates at (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size): - Counts (distinct primary_email): total_contacts; marketing_contacts when marketo_lead_id present; sales_contacts when stripe_customer_id present; support_contacts when zendesk_user_id present. - Journey distribution: full_journey_contacts when journey pattern = "Full Journey"; also compute marketing_to_sales_contacts and sales_to_support_contacts (used downstream). - Value metrics: total_organization_ltv (sum of estimated_customer_ltv), avg_customer_ltv, highest_customer_ltv (max), total_adjusted_ltv (sum). - Engagement/health: avg_engagement_score (average composite_engagement_score), max_engagement_score (max), avg_health_score (average customer_health_score). - Strategic classification: strategic_accounts, key_accounts, growth_accounts, recovery_accounts from strategic_classification. - Revenue tiers: tier1_contacts, tier2_contacts, tier3_contacts from revenue_tier. - Customer segments: champions, loyal_customers, at_risk_customers from customer_segment. - Lifecycle stages (for health calc): growth_stage_contacts when stage = "Growth"; maturity_stage_contacts when stage = "Maturity"; dormant_contacts when stage = "Dormant". - Diversity: email_domains_count = distinct email_domain within the group (will be 1); customer_tiers_represented = distinct customer_tier. - Compute organization_scoring: - organization_value_score: weighted sum of three 1–5 tiers, rounded to two decimals (stored with one-decimal precision): - LTV tier: ≥50000→5; ≥25000→4; ≥10000→3; ≥5000→2; else→1 (weight 0.4). - Contacts tier: ≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - Avg engagement tier: ≥4.0→5; ≥3.0→4; ≥2.5→3; ≥2.0→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - organization_health_score: 0.4×avg_health_score + 0.3×(champions+loyal_customers)/total_contacts×5 + 0.3×(growth_stage_contacts+maturity_stage_contacts)/total_contacts×5; if total_contacts=0, both ratios are 0; round to two decimals. - account_penetration_score: share of contacts linked across marketing, sales, and support out of three touchpoints, scaled to a 0–5 score and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - organization_maturity: - if total_contacts≥10 and full_journey_contacts≥3 → Mature Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 and (strategic_accounts+key_accounts)≥2 → Developing Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥3 and total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Mid-Market - else if total_contacts≥2 → Small Business - else → Individual/Micro - growth_potential: - if growth_accounts≥2 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → High Growth Potential - else if growth_accounts≥1 or avg_engagement_score≥3.5 → Medium Growth Potential - else if total_contacts≥2 and avg_health_score≥3.0 → Stable Growth Potential - else → Limited Growth Potential - organization_risk_level: - if at_risk_customers ≥ 50% of total_contacts → High Risk - else if dormant_contacts ≥ 30% of total_contacts → Medium Risk - else if recovery_accounts ≥ 1 → Attention Needed - else → Stable - strategic_value_tier: - if strategic_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥100000 → Strategic Enterprise - else if key_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥50000 → Key Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 or total_organization_ltv≥25000 → Important Account - else if total_contacts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Standard Account - else → Small Account - engagement_breadth_percentage: weighted coverage across marketing (30%), sales (40%), and support (30%) among contacts, expressed as a percentage and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - concentration_risk: - if total_contacts=1 → High Concentration Risk - else if total_contacts≤3 → Medium Concentration Risk - else if email_domains_count=1 and total_contacts≥5 → Domain Concentration Risk - else → Low Concentration Risk - Perform network_analysis: - market_share_within_type: percent share of total_organization_ltv within the same organization_type, rounded to four decimals; null when the type total is zero. - Rankings within organization_type: ltv_rank_within_type by total_organization_ltv descending; contacts_rank_within_type by total_contacts descending; value_score_rank_within_type by organization_value_score descending; ties break arbitrarily. - cross_sell_opportunity_score (integer 0–7): sum of three components, then rounded (remains integer): - Channel gap: if total_contacts≥5 and marketing_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥3 and sales_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥2 and support_contacts=0 →2; else →0. - Growth: High Growth Potential →2; Medium Growth Potential →1; else →0. - Engagement: avg_engagement_score≥3.5 →2; ≥3.0 →1; else →0. - expansion_priority: - if strategic_value_tier in {Strategic Enterprise, Key Enterprise} and growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Immediate Expansion - else if organization_value_score≥4.0 and organization_health_score≥4.0 → High Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥3 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → Medium Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥2 and organization_risk_level=Stable → Low Priority Expansion - else → Maintenance Mode - recommended_strategy: - if organization_risk_level=High Risk → Risk Mitigation & Recovery - else if strategic_value_tier=Strategic Enterprise → White Glove Account Management - else if strategic_value_tier=Key Enterprise → Dedicated Account Management - else if growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Growth & Expansion Focus - else if total_contacts=1 → Relationship Expansion - else → Standard Account Management - Finalization: - organization_influence_score: weighted score rounded to two decimals = 0.3×organization_value_score + 0.3×contacts tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1) + 0.2×breadth tier (≥80→5; ≥60→4; ≥40→3; ≥20→2; else→1) + 0.2×market-share tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥2→3; ≥1→2; else→1). - risk_adjusted_organization_value: total_adjusted_ltv multiplied by expansion priority multiplier (Immediate 1.5; High 1.3; Medium 1.1; else 1.0), then reduced by risk penalty (High Risk 40%; Medium Risk 20%; Attention Needed 10%; else 0%), rounded to two decimals. - network_analysis_timestamp: set to the current timestamp at computation time. - Exclude rows where standardized_org_name = "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - Order output by organization_influence_score (desc), then total_organization_ltv (desc), then total_contacts (desc).'
      columns:
      - name: standardized_org_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Uppercased, trimmed organization name from behavior_analysis; null/blank becomes 'INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER' and is excluded from final output
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Substring after '@' in primary_email; if missing set to 'unknown.domain'
      - name: organization_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from primary_organization patterns: Individual, Corporation, Education, Government, Non-Profit, or Business'
      - name: estimated_org_size
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Size class from email_domain and name length: Personal, Enterprise, Large/Medium/Small Business, or Individual'
      - name: organization_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mature Enterprise if contacts≥10 and full_journey≥3; Developing Enterprise if contacts≥5 and strategic+key≥2; Mid-Market if contacts≥3 and org LTV≥10000; Small Business if contacts≥2; else Individual/Micro
      - name: strategic_value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategic Enterprise if strategic≥2 or org LTV≥100000; Key Enterprise if key≥2 or org LTV≥50000; Important if contacts≥5 or org LTV≥25000; Standard if contacts≥2 or org LTV≥10000; else Small
      - name: total_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of primary_email within the group
      - name: marketing_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count with a marketo_lead_id present
      - name: sales_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count with a stripe_customer_id present
      - name: support_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count with a zendesk_user_id present
      - name: email_domains_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of email_domain within the group; equals 1 due to grouping by email_domain
      - name: customer_tiers_represented
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of customer_tier values within the group
      - name: total_organization_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Sum of estimated_customer_ltv over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: total_adjusted_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,3)
        description: Sum of adjusted_ltv over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: avg_customer_ltv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of estimated_customer_ltv over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: highest_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Maximum estimated_customer_ltv over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: risk_adjusted_organization_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: Total_adjusted_ltv scaled by expansion priority multiplier and reduced by risk penalty; rounded to two decimals
      - name: organization_value_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Weighted score from LTV tier (40%), contacts tier (30%), and avg engagement tier (30%); rounded and stored with one-decimal precision
      - name: organization_influence_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Weighted score from value score, contacts tier, engagement breadth tier, and market share tier; rounded to two decimals
      - name: avg_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average composite_engagement_score over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: max_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Maximum composite_engagement_score over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: avg_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average customer_health_score over grouped rows; null if all values are null
      - name: organization_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted composite of avg_health_score and stage/segment ratios using total_contacts as denominator; rounded to two decimals
      - name: account_penetration_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Scaled 0–5 score of contact presence across marketing, sales, and support relative to all contacts; rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0
      - name: engagement_breadth_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted coverage across marketing (30%), sales (40%), and support (30%) as a percentage; rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0
      - name: full_journey_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where customer_journey_pattern is 'Full Journey'
      - name: strategic_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where strategic_classification is 'Strategic Account'
      - name: key_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where strategic_classification is 'Key Account'
      - name: growth_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where strategic_classification is 'Growth Account'
      - name: recovery_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where strategic_classification is 'Recovery Account'
      - name: champions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where customer_segment is 'Champion'
      - name: loyal_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where customer_segment is 'Loyal Customer'
      - name: at_risk_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where customer_segment is 'At Risk'
      - name: tier1_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where revenue_tier is 'Tier 1 - Strategic'
      - name: tier2_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where revenue_tier is 'Tier 2 - High Value'
      - name: tier3_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct primary_email count where revenue_tier is 'Tier 3 - Core'
      - name: organization_risk_level

      - name: concentration_risk

      - name: growth_potential

      - name: value_score_rank_within_type
        data_type: BIGINT

    - name: customer360__phone
      description: Distinct phones with extensions collected from Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk, deduplicated per customer and assigned a per-customer index ordered by phone ascending.
      grain: One row per (customer360_id, phone, extension)
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Use marts.customer360__mapping to link each customer360_id to source records. - For each source, inner join via mapped IDs and collect phone fields only when the phone is not NULL; keep values as-is (no trimming or normalization): - Marketo: phone/phone_extension, company_phone/company_phone_extension, mobile_phone/mobile_phone_extension via mapping.marketo_lead_id = marketo.lead_id. - Stripe: phone/phone_extension, shipping_phone/shipping_phone_extension via mapping.stripe_customer_id = stripe.customer_id. - Zendesk: phone/phone_extension via mapping.zendesk_user_id = zendesk.user_id. - Combine all collected phones across sources without altering values; any per-source index or source label is not retained. - Remove duplicates by exact match of (customer360_id, phone, extension); NULL extensions are allowed and treated as equal for duplicate checking. - Per customer360_id, assign a sequential index starting at 1 based on phone sorted ascending; extension does not affect sort; ties where phone strings are identical (with different extensions) have unspecified order; indices are contiguous with no gaps. - Output columns: customer360_id, phone, extension, index.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer 360 identifier; phones are grouped and indexed per customer.
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone string from sources; NULL phones are excluded; value is preserved; used for deduplication and ascending sort for indexing.
      - name: extension
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Optional phone extension; included in deduplication; not used for sorting.
      - name: index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Per-customer sequential index starting at 1 after deduplication, ordered by phone ascending; tie order for identical phone strings is unspecified; no gaps.
    - name: customer360__status
      description: Unified customer communication preferences and account status aggregated across Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk
      grain: One row per customer360_id
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Start from marts.customer360__mapping to relate customer360_id to source IDs (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id). - Marketo: - Inner join mapping → intermediate.int_customer360__marketo on marketo_lead_id = lead_id. - Carry is_unsubscribed, is_email_invalid, do_not_call from Marketo as-is. - Derive per-row source_system = ''marketo'' and status: unsubscribed if is_unsubscribed is TRUE; else email_invalid if is_email_invalid is TRUE; else do_not_call if do_not_call is TRUE; else active. - Stripe: - Inner join mapping → intermediate.int_customer360__stripe on stripe_customer_id = customer_id. - Set is_unsubscribed, is_email_invalid, do_not_call to FALSE. - Derive per-row source_system = ''stripe'' and status: delinquent if is_delinquent is TRUE; else deleted if is_deleted is TRUE; else active. - Zendesk: - Inner join mapping → intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk on zendesk_user_id = user_id. - Set is_unsubscribed, is_email_invalid, do_not_call to FALSE. - Derive per-row source_system = ''zendesk'' and status: suspended if is_suspended is TRUE; else deleted if is_deleted is TRUE; else inactive if is_active is FALSE; else active. - Union all rows from the three systems. - Aggregate by customer360_id: - For each of is_unsubscribed, is_email_invalid, and do_not_call: take the logical OR across all rows (TRUE if any TRUE; FALSE if none TRUE and at least one FALSE; NULL only if all inputs are NULL). Stripe and Zendesk always contribute FALSE. - overall_status precedence: 1) unsubscribed if the aggregated unsubscribe flag is TRUE; 2) email_invalid if the aggregated email_invalid flag is TRUE; 3) active if any per-row status is active; 4) suspended if any per-row status is suspended; 5) delinquent if any per-row status is delinquent; 6) otherwise inactive. Note: per-row statuses deleted and do_not_call never map directly to the final status. - source_systems: concatenate the distinct source_system values present using ", " as the delimiter; remove duplicates; do not enforce ordering. - Output one row per customer360_id that appears in at least one of the three joined systems.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer surrogate key; exactly one output row per customer360_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: is_unsubscribed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any contributing row is TRUE; FALSE if none TRUE and at least one FALSE (Stripe/Zendesk contribute FALSE); NULL only if all inputs are NULL
      - name: is_email_invalid
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any contributing row is TRUE; FALSE if none TRUE and at least one FALSE (Stripe/Zendesk contribute FALSE); NULL only if all inputs are NULL
      - name: do_not_call
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if any contributing row is TRUE; FALSE if none TRUE and at least one FALSE (Stripe/Zendesk contribute FALSE); NULL only if all inputs are NULL
      - name: overall_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Final status with precedence: unsubscribed > email_invalid > active (if any) > suspended (if any) > delinquent (if any) > inactive; values limited to {unsubscribed, email_invalid, active, suspended, delinquent, inactive}'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: source_systems
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma+space separated distinct list of contributing systems; duplicates removed; ordering unspecified; never NULL
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: customer360__summary
      description: Summary per customer360_id with first-ranked profile fields joined to all IP address records.
      grain: One row per customer360_id per ip_address record; if any ranked source has multiple index=1 or rank=1 rows for an id, rows multiply accordingly; if no ip_address exists, one row per customer360_id.
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - marts.customer360__email
      - marts.customer360__phone
      - marts.customer360__name
      - marts.customer360__organization

                 config_path: str = "config/layer_dependencies.yaml"):
        self.source_db_path = source_db_path
        self.target_db_path = target_db_path
        self.config_path = config_path
        self.config = self._load_config()
        self.sql_dir = Path("sql")
        
        self.schema_config = {
            'raw': 'raw',                                           
            'staging': 'staging',                                  
            'intermediate': 'intermediate',                                                         
            'marts': 'marts'                                                        
        }
        
        self.conn = None
        
    def _load_config(self) -> dict:
        """Load the configuration file"""
        try:
            with open(self.config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                return yaml.safe_load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            logger.error(f"Configuration file {self.config_path} not found")
            raise
        except yaml.YAMLError as e:
            logger.error(f"Configuration file parsing error: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _initialize_database(self):
        """Initialize the working database, create the layered schema architecture, and import raw data"""
        logger.info(f"📥 Creating a new layered database: {self.target_db_path}")
        
        if not os.path.exists(self.source_db_path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Source database file not found: {self.source_db_path}")
        
        self.conn = duckdb.connect(self.target_db_path)
        
        self._create_schemas()
        
        self._import_raw_data()
        
        logger.info(f"✓ Layered database initialization complete: {self.target_db_path}")
    
    def _create_schemas(self):
        """Create the schemas for the data layers"""
        logger.info("🏗️ Creating Schema layered architecture")
        
        for layer, schema_name in self.schema_config.items():
            try:
                self.conn.execute(f"CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {schema_name}")
                logger.info(f"  ✓ Created schema: {schema_name}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"  ✗ Failed to create schema {schema_name}: {e}")
                raise
    
    def _import_raw_data(self):
        """Import raw data from the source database to the raw schema"""
        logger.info("📥 Importing raw data to the raw schema")
        
        try:
            source_conn = duckdb.connect(self.source_db_path)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Unable to connect to source database {self.source_db_path}: {e}")
            raise
        
        try:
            try:
                tables_result = source_conn.execute("SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'raw'").fetchall()
                source_tables = [table[0] for table in tables_result]
            except:
                tables_result = source_conn.execute("SHOW TABLES").fetchall()
                source_tables = [table[0] for table in tables_result]
            
            logger.info(f"Found {len(source_tables)} raw tables")
            
            for table_name in source_tables:
                try:
                    try:
                        data = source_conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM raw.{table_name}").fetchall()
                        columns_info = source_conn.execute(f"DESCRIBE raw.{table_name}").fetchall()
                        source_table_ref = f"raw.{table_name}"
                    except:
                        data = source_conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {table_name}").fetchall()
                        columns_info = source_conn.execute(f"DESCRIBE {table_name}").fetchall()
                        source_table_ref = table_name
                    
                    column_defs = []
                    for col_info in columns_info:
                        col_name, col_type = col_info[0], col_info[1]
                        if col_name.lower() in ['end', 'start', 'order', 'group', 'select', 'from', 'where']:
                            safe_col_name = f'"{col_name}"'
                        else:
                            safe_col_name = col_name
                        column_defs.append(f"{safe_col_name} {col_type}")
                    
                    create_sql = f"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE raw.{table_name} ({', '.join(column_defs)})"
                    self.conn.execute(create_sql)
                    
                    if data:
                        placeholders = ', '.join(['?' for _ in columns_info])
                        insert_sql = f"INSERT INTO raw.{table_name} VALUES ({placeholders})"
                        self.conn.executemany(insert_sql, data)
                    
                    logger.info(f"  ✓ raw.{table_name}: {len(data)} rows")
                    
                except Exception as e:

            source_conn.close()
        
        logger.info("✓ Raw data import complete")
    
    def _load_sql_file(self, file_path: Path) -> str:

        try:

            logger.info(f"Executing: {full_table_name}")
            self.conn.execute(create_table_sql)
            
            count_result = self.conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {full_table_name}").fetchone()
            row_count = count_result[0] if count_result else 0
            
            logger.info(f"✓ {full_table_name}: {row_count:,} rows")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"✗ {full_table_name}: {e}")
            return False
    
    def _process_sql_references(self, sql: str, current_layer: str) -> str:
        """Process table references in SQL, converting them to schema.table format"""
        processed_sql = sql
        
        table_mappings = {

            'intermediate.int_customer360__risk_assessment': 'intermediate.int_customer360__risk_assessment',

            'marts.customer360__email': 'marts.customer360__email',

            'marts.customer360__name': 'marts.customer360__name',

), scored as (

 round(100*(.3*marketing_contacts+.4*sales_contacts+.3*support_contacts)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0),2) as engagement_breadth_percentage,
 case when total_contacts>=10 and full_journey_contacts>=3 then 'Mature Enterprise' when total_contacts>=5 and strategic_accounts+key_accounts>=2 then 'Developing Enterprise' when total_contacts>=3 and total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 'Mid-Market' when total_contacts>=2 then 'Small Business' else 'Individual/Micro' end as organization_maturity,

with base as (

 am.activity_grade,am.weighted_engagement_score,am.primary_engagement_channel

), stage as (

 case when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 and in_zendesk=1 then 3 when in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk>=2 then 2 when in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk=1 then 1 else 0 end as journey_completeness_score,
 case when marketing_to_sales_days is null then 'Direct to Sales' when marketing_to_sales_days<=30 then 'Fast' when marketing_to_sales_days<=90 then 'Medium' when marketing_to_sales_days<=180 then 'Slow' else 'Very Slow' end as awareness_to_conversion_speed,
 case when sales_to_support_days is null then 'No Support Needed' when sales_to_support_days<=7 then 'Immediate' when sales_to_support_days<=30 then 'Quick' when sales_to_support_days<=90 then 'Standard' else 'Delayed' end as conversion_to_support_speed,
 case when marketing_to_sales_days is null then 'Direct to Sales' when marketing_to_sales_days<=60 then 'High Efficiency' when marketing_to_sales_days<=120 then 'Medium Efficiency' else 'Low Efficiency' end as funnel_efficiency,
 case when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 and marketing_to_sales_days<=60 then 'High Efficiency' when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 and marketing_to_sales_days<=120 then 'Medium Efficiency' when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 then 'Low Efficiency' when in_stripe=1 and in_marketo=0 then 'Direct Conversion' else 'No Conversion' end as funnel_efficiency_full
 from base
), metrics as (

 when reached_conversion=1 and reached_support=0 then case when stripe_engagement>=4 and customer_tier in ('Platinum','Gold') then .75 when stripe_engagement>=3 and customer_tier in ('Gold','Silver') then .60 when stripe_engagement>=2 then .45 else .25 end else 1.00 end::decimal(3,2) as next_stage_conversion_probability,

 case when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 and account_age_days>180 then 'High Drop-off Risk' when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 and marketo_engagement<=2 then 'Medium Drop-off Risk' when reached_conversion=1 and reached_support=0 and stripe_engagement<=2 then 'Support Adoption Risk' else 'Low Drop-off Risk' end as drop_off_risk,
 case when reached_conversion=1 and estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed='Fast' then 'Quick Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 and estimated_customer_ltv>=2000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Fast','Medium') then 'Standard Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Slow','Very Slow') then 'Delayed Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 then 'Unknown Value Timeline' else 'Pre-Value Stage' end as value_realization_pattern,
 case when journey_completeness_score=3 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=60 then 'Accelerated Journey' when journey_completeness_score>=2 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=120 then 'Standard Journey' when journey_completeness_score>=1 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=300 then 'Slow Journey' else 'Stalled Journey' end as journey_velocity
 from stage
), prepared as (

 case when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.7 and estimated_customer_ltv>=3000 then 'Critical Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 or estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 'High Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.4 then 'Medium Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.2 then 'Low Priority' else 'Monitor Only' end as intervention_priority

 round(cross_stage_engagement_consistency,2) as cross_stage_engagement_consistency,weighted_engagement_score,primary_engagement_channel,next_stage_conversion_probability,

 expected_optimization_value,intervention_priority,
 case when journey_completeness_score=3 then 'Maintain Full Journey Excellence' when journey_completeness_score=2 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 then 'Complete Journey Progression' when journey_completeness_score=1 and drop_off_risk='Low Drop-off Risk' then 'Advance to Next Stage' when drop_off_risk in ('High Drop-off Risk','Medium Drop-off Risk') then 'Prevent Drop-off' else 'Engage and Qualify' end as success_target,
 funnel_performance_grade,round(.3*journey_completeness_score+.3*case journey_velocity when 'Accelerated Journey' then 5 when 'Standard Journey' then 4 when 'Slow Journey' then 2 else 1 end+.4*cross_stage_engagement_consistency,2) as journey_efficiency_index,

from enriched order by intervention_priority desc,expected_optimization_value desc,journey_efficiency_index desc,predictive_full_journey_probability desc''')

        coalesce(f.ms_stripe_id, sz.stripe_id) as stripe_id,
